channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Riyadh, China discuss Houthis as group claims Aramco attacks
item.description: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi drones heading for Riyadh as the rebel group claims attacks on energy facilities.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis renew strikes on Saudi Arabia as UNSC extends sanctions
item.description: Saudi-led coalition intercepts flurry of suspected Houthi drones targeting oil and military infrastructure.

item.title: Deadly shooting in Washington DC
item.description: Police in the US capital are investigating a shooting around a mile from the White House that led to one person killed

item.title: Iranian men guilty of spying on British journalists
item.description: Two Iranian men were convicted under Britain's National Security Act for spying on dissident journalists.

item.title: Al Jazeera reports from Gaza hospital attacked by Israel
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Tareq Abu Azzoum reports on the aftermath of an Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital

item.title: Suspect turns gun on himself after deadly shooting in Washington DC
item.description: Police say the man suspected to have killed one person in a shooting in Washington DC appears to have shot himself.

item.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
item.description: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

item.title: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang
item.description: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.

item.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
item.description: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.

item.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
item.description: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.
